description: Questions written for PortfolioIQ that are not in the assessment's ground truth and are not templates of the semantic layer's verified examples. Reference SQL and expected results were written by hand and are checked by tests/test_unseen_questions.py.

questions.question: Which portfolios hold NVIDIA?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE s.symbol = 'NVDA';
questions.tests: join across three tables, symbol lookup from a company name

questions.question: How many holdings does the Dividend Aristocrats Fund have?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Dividend Aristocrats Fund';
questions.tests: count with an exact portfolio name

questions.question: At current prices, how much are the bonds held across all portfolios worth?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE s.asset_type = 'Bond';
questions.tests: market value definition (D2, D4) with an asset-class filter

questions.question: List each bond with its coupon rate and maturity date.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT symbol, coupon_rate, maturity_date FROM securities WHERE asset_type = 'Bond';

questions.question: Most recent beta for the Conservative Income Fund?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.beta FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Conservative Income Fund' AND r.calculation_date = (SELECT MAX(calculation_date) FROM risk_metrics);
questions.tests: latest date by default (B9) on the risk table

questions.question: How many BUY transactions were made in the past 7 days?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'BUY' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-10-03' AND '2023-10-09';
questions.tests: relative date anchored to the dataset (B10)

questions.question: Which portfolios have never had their performance recorded?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id NOT IN (SELECT portfolio_id FROM portfolio_performance);

questions.question: What is the average purchase price paid for Apple across all portfolios?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(h.purchase_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE s.symbol = 'AAPL';
questions.tests: aggregate over one security in many portfolios

questions.question: Show all transactions from last year.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31';
questions.tests: previous calendar year relative to the dataset (B10); honest empty result

questions.question: Which sector has the most securities?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sec.sector_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY sec.sector_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
questions.tests: group, rank and take the top row
